Distribution of the origin and NOVA scores (times/day) in each diet group.
Pairwise Wilcoxon tests, BH-adjusted within each panel.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggpubr)

table_dir <- here("1.-FFQ_analysis", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("1.-FFQ_analysis", "Results", "Plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r theme set, include=FALSE}
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()))

diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")
```


# Data load

```{r data load}
analysis_data <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "analysis_data.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
score_info <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "score_info.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(system != "NOVA (sensitivity)")

scores_long <- analysis_data %>%
  select(sample_id, diet_group, all_of(score_info$score)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(score_info$score), names_to = "score", values_to = "times_day") %>%
  left_join(score_info, by = "score") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         label = factor(label, levels = unique(score_info$label)))
```


# Summary by diet group

```{r summary}
scores_summary <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(system, label, diet_group) %>%
  summarise(median = median(times_day),
            q1 = quantile(times_day, 0.25),
            q3 = quantile(times_day, 0.75),
            .groups = "drop")

kruskal_results <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(system, label) %>%
  summarise(p_value = kruskal.test(times_day ~ diet_group)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(system) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

kruskal_results

# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests, BH-adjusted within each score: the same tests geom_pwc draws on the plots below,
# saved so that the manuscript figures and text can quote them
pairwise_results <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(system, label) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, key) {
    pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(d$times_day, d$diet_group, p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE)$p.value
    as.data.frame(as.table(pw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Freq)) %>%
      transmute(group1 = as.character(Var2), group2 = as.character(Var1), p_adj = Freq)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

pairwise_results %>% mutate(p_adj = signif(p_adj, 3)) %>% print(n = Inf)
```


# Plots

```{r plot function}
plot_scores <- function(system_i) {
  ggplot(scores_long %>% filter(system == system_i),
         aes(x = diet_group, y = times_day, colour = diet_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = diet_group),
                colour = "black",
                width = 0.18,
                height = 0,
                pch = 21,
                size = 1.7,
                alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors, name = "Diet group") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors, name = "Diet group") +
    facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free_y") +
    geom_pwc(method = "wilcox_test",
             label = "p.adj.signif",
             p.adjust.method = "BH",
             p.adjust.by = "panel",
             hide.ns = "p.adj") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Times/day")
}
```

```{r origin, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
plot_origin <- plot_scores("Origin")
plot_origin
```

```{r nova, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 7}
plot_nova <- plot_scores("NOVA")
plot_nova
```


# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(scores_summary, file.path(table_dir, "scores_by_diet_summary.tsv"))
write_tsv(kruskal_results, file.path(table_dir, "scores_by_diet_kruskal.tsv"))
write_tsv(pairwise_results, file.path(table_dir, "scores_by_diet_pairwise.tsv"))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Origin_by_diet.png"), plot_origin, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "NOVA_by_diet.png"), plot_nova, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
